cmd: I need a precise citation. For the paper "Sparse Routing for Efficient Multimodal Retrieval" by K. Okafor, L. Brennan, and M. Sato (2023), give me: the exact arXiv ID, the venue it appeared in, and the reported top-1 recall on MSCOCO text-to-image retrieval. Verify the details before answering. Answer in at most 120 words.

args.query: Sparse Routing for Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Okafor Brennan Sato

queries: "Sparse Routing for Efficient Multimodal Retrieval" Okafor Brennan Sato

args.command: curl -s "http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=ti:%22Sparse+Routing+for+Efficient+Multimodal+Retrieval%22&max_results=5" | head -40; echo "-----"; curl -s "http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=au:Okafor+AND+au:Sato&max_results=10" | grep -E "<title>|<id>" | head -20

args.query: Sparse Routing for Efficient Multimodal Retrieval

args.command: curl -s "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=ti:%22Sparse%20Routing%20for%20Efficient%20Multimodal%20Retrieval%22&max_results=5" | grep -E "totalResults|<title>|<id>"; echo "=== author check ==="; curl -s "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=au:Okafor_M%20AND%20au:Sato&max_results=5" | grep -E "totalResults|<title>|<id>"; echo "=== title words ==="; curl -s "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=ti:%22Sparse%20Routing%22&max_results=10" | grep -E "totalResults|<title>|<id>"
